name: Koha
description: Koha library system (OPAC, staff client, MariaDB, Memcached, Zebra). This domain serves both. The catalog is the site root. The back office is /cgi-bin/koha/mainpage.pl. Upgrade Koha by pulling latest on boot, plack, web, cron, zebra, zebraidx, jobs, and long (image tag stable; that pull is a new Koha release and can migrate the existing database). Do not pull latest, reinstall, or delete db or cache; db holds the catalog.

components.command: -c 'cd /docker && set -euo pipefail; chmod 755 /etc/koha/sites; if [ -f /var/lib/koha/koha-bootstrapped ]; then exec sleep infinity; fi; export KOHA_SERVICE=init; /docker/run.sh; chmod 755 /etc/koha/sites; apache2ctl stop || true; koha-worker --stop --queue default koha || true; koha-worker --stop --queue long_tasks koha || true; exec sleep infinity'

-c 'cd /docker && while [ ! -f /var/lib/koha/koha-bootstrapped ]; do sleep 5; done; if ! id koha-koha >/dev/null 2>&1; then adduser --no-create-home --disabled-password --gecos "Koha instance koha-koha" --home /var/lib/koha/koha --quiet koha-koha; fi; koha-create-dirs koha || true; export KOHA_HOME=/usr/share/koha KOHA_CONF=/etc/koha/sites/koha/koha-conf.xml PERL5LIB=/usr/share/koha/lib; exec /usr/bin/starman -M FindBin --max-requests 50 --workers 2 -E deployment --listen 0.0.0.0:5000 --access-log /dev/stdout --error-log /dev/stderr /etc/koha/plack.psgi'

-c 'while [ ! -f /var/lib/koha/koha-bootstrapped ]; do sleep 2; done; if mysql --user="$DB_USER" --password="$DB_PASSWORD" --host=127.0.0.1 --batch --skip-column-names koha_koha -e "SELECT value FROM systempreferences WHERE variable="Version"" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then printf " " > /usr/share/koha/opac/htdocs/install-login.html; else printf "Koha installer

Open the Koha installer and sign in using the credentials in your secure deployment configuration.

" > /usr/share/koha/opac/htdocs/install-login.html; fi; sed -i "/AssignUserID/d" /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/*.conf /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf; for f in /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/*.conf /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac-plack.conf; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; grep -q intranet/installer "$f" && continue; grep -q "5000/opac" "$f" || continue; sed -i "s#ProxyPass /cgi-bin/koha#ProxyPass /cgi-bin/koha/installer http://127.0.0.1:5000/intranet/installer ProxyPassReverse /cgi-bin/koha/installer http://127.0.0.1:5000/intranet/installer ProxyPass /cgi-bin/koha#" "$f"; done; grep -q "X-Forwarded-Proto" /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf || printf " RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "https" " >> /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf; for f in /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac-plack.conf /etc/koha/apache-shared-intranet-plack.conf; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; sed -i "/X-FORWARDED-PROTO/s/ env=HTTPS//; /X-Forwarded-Proto/s/ env=HTTPS//" "$f"; done; if [ -n "$KOHA_PUBLIC_URL" ]; then mysql --user="$DB_USER" --password="$DB_PASSWORD" --host=127.0.0.1 koha_koha -e "UPDATE systempreferences SET value="$KOHA_PUBLIC_URL" WHERE variable IN ("OPACBaseURL","staffClientBaseURL");" || true; fi; perl -MIO::Socket::INET -e "my \$s=IO::Socket::INET->new(PeerAddr=>qq{127.0.0.1:11211},Timeout=>2) or exit 0; print \$s qq{flush_all };"; grep -q "Alias /intranet-tmpl" /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf || printf " Alias /intranet-tmpl /usr/share/koha/intranet/htdocs/intranet-tmpl Require all granted " >> /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf; grep -q "AliasMatch" /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf || printf "AliasMatch ^(/intranet-tmpl/.*)_[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{7}\.(js|css)\$ /usr/share/koha/intranet/htdocs\$1.\$2 " >> /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf; perl -pi -e "s/ \[L\]/ [PT,L]/ if /js\|css/" /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac.conf; sed -i -E "/ProxyPass(Reverse)? /cgi-bin/koha[[:space:]]/ { //opac/d; }" /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac-plack.conf; grep -q lightserve-staff-on-opac /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac-plack.conf || printf " # lightserve-staff-on-opac RewriteEngine On RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/opac-(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/opac-\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/errors/(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/errors/\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/sco/(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/sco/\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/oai.pl(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/oai.pl\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/ilsdi.pl(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/ilsdi.pl\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/unapi(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/unapi\$1 [P,L] RewriteCond %%{HTTP_REFERER} /cgi-bin/koha/ RewriteCond %%{HTTP_REFERER} !/cgi-bin/koha/opac RewriteCond %%{HTTP_REFERER} !/cgi-bin/koha/errors/ RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/svc/(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/intranet/svc/\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/svc/(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/svc/\$1 [P,L] RewriteRule ^/cgi-bin/koha/(.*)\$ http://127.0.0.1:5000/intranet/\$1 [P,L] ProxyPassReverse /cgi-bin/koha/opac- http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/opac- ProxyPassReverse /cgi-bin/koha/errors/ http://127.0.0.1:5000/opac/errors/ ProxyPassReverse /cgi-bin/koha http://127.0.0.1:5000/intranet " >> /etc/koha/apache-shared-opac-plack.conf; a2dismod -f mpm_itk; a2enmod mpm_prefork rewrite headers; export KOHA_SERVICE=apache; exec /docker/run.sh'
-c 'while [ ! -f /var/lib/koha/koha-bootstrapped ]; do sleep 5; done; export KOHA_SERVICE=cron; exec /docker/run.sh'

post_install: Open {{url_no_trailing}}/install-login.html to reach the Koha installer. Sign in using the instance database credentials from your secure deployment configuration. Automatic browser login is disabled to avoid credential disclosure.
That staff login is located at {{url_no_trailing}}/cgi-bin/koha/mainpage.pl .

Before deploying this recipe, run Let's Encrypt on the virtual server that will host Koha, whether that is the main virtual server or a sub server, so the SSL certificate is already in place. Turn on the redirect from HTTP to HTTPS. Koha learns the public HTTPS address from that proxy.

To upgrade Koha, dump the database first, then Pull latest and reinstall only these containers: boot, plack, web, cron, zebra, zebraidx, jobs, long. They all use koha/koha:stable, so Pull latest downloads the latest Koha release and can run schema updates on the existing catalog.

Do not Pull latest, reinstall, or delete db or cache. db is the bibliographic and patron data. cache is Memcached and is not part of a Koha upgrade. Deleting the recipe deletes the catalog unless you keep the volumes.
